prBodyNotes: This PR was opened by the Renovate GitHub App. Routine updates run weekly (Mon pre-6am ET), grouped and concurrency-capped; security advisories open immediately with a `security` label. This repo has NO pull-request CI, so green checks prove nothing here: NOTHING auto-merges (security included) and every PR waits for human review. Merging to the default branch may auto-deploy. Pattern documented in afterimagelabs/cms docs/dependency-automation.md.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Stabilization window — let routine releases bake before we adopt them (does NOT apply to security PRs, which run via vulnerabilityAlerts).

Production npm deps (non-major), grouped into one weekly PR. NOT auto-merged on purpose: merge to main auto-deploys to prod, and green CI under-proves a runtime dep's safety in this repo (supabase-js resolves {error} instead of throwing; mocked tests have passed while prod was broken). A human reviews these.
devDependencies (non-major), grouped. Would be the auto-merge safe tier, but this repo has no PR CI, so it is human-reviewed.
All @types/* together. Would be the auto-merge safe tier, but this repo has no PR CI, so it is human-reviewed.
GitHub Actions minor/patch/digest, grouped. Would be the auto-merge safe tier, but this repo has no PR CI, so it is human-reviewed.

Runtime Docker base image (node:* / python:*). All FROM lines move together in one labeled PR; majors also show on the dashboard so an EOL cannot silently rot. NOT auto-merged: a runtime bump always gets a human.
Other Docker images (compose services such as postgres/redis/mongo) — grouped, non-runtime, human-reviewed.
Major bumps — always human-reviewed, one at a time (config:recommended opens them individually). Labeled for visibility. This also catches GitHub Actions majors.
